results.why: EUR 75k web/CMS project. Raw DCE shows no numeric turnover minimum, no fixed reference-count/value selection threshold, no named certification and no fixed staffing threshold. Latest official notice extends submission to 7 September 2026. Every award criterion has a 60% minimum score, including similar-sector experience and Irish-language experience, so a credible Gaeilge/web partner is prudent. Subcontracting is contemplated, with prior approval for material subcontracting.
